ActionRequest.title: ActionRequest
ActionRequest.description:
The calling owner's ``values``, the generation form (``core``) and
the other owners' values (``scripts``); extra keys are the action's own
arguments (``selected``, ``label``, ``preset``, ...).

dirname.title: Dirname
dirname.description: folder name under extensions/ (default: from the URL)

access.title: Access
access.description: whether this server allows installing, updating and toggling extensions

disabled.title: Disabled
disabled.description: names of the extensions to disable (the others are enabled)

ImageInfo.title: ImageInfo
ImageInfo.description: What PNG Info shows for an image, plus its parsed parameters.

NotPorted.title: NotPorted
NotPorted.description: A script, Extras operation or extension tab not on ``params()`` yet.

id_task.title: Task ID
id_task.description: id of the task to get progress for

id_live_preview.title: Live preview image ID
id_live_preview.description: id of last received last preview image

live_preview.title: Include live preview
live_preview.description: boolean flag indicating whether to include the live preview image

active.title: Whether the task is being worked on right now

queued.title: Whether the task is in queue

completed.title: Whether the task has already finished

progress.title: Progress
progress.description: The progress with a range of 0 to 1

live_preview.title: Live preview image
live_preview.description: Current live preview; a data: uri

id_live_preview.title: Live preview image ID
id_live_preview.description: Send this together with next request to prevent receiving same image

order.title: Order
order.description: queued job ids in their new order; jobs keep their priority, so the order applies within each priority

saved.title: Saved
saved.description: saved file names, relative to the Save folder

zip.title: Zip
zip.description: file id of the zip archive (download with /files/{id}?download=true)

UserMetadataPatch.title: UserMetadataPatch
UserMetadataPatch.description: Keys to set (``null`` removes one); ``replace`` drops the others.
